mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SAGA_INSTANCE (SAGA_ID, SAGA_TYPE, STATUS, CURRENT_STEP) VALUES (#{SAGA_ID}, #{SAGA_TYPE}, #{STATUS}, #{CURRENT_STEP})
mapper.select: SELECT SAGA_ID, SAGA_TYPE, STATUS, CURRENT_STEP, CREATED_DT, UPDATED_DT FROM TB_SAGA_INSTANCE WHERE 1=1 AND SAGA_ID = #{SAGA_ID}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SAGA_STEP_HISTORY (SAGA_ID, STEP_NAME, RESULT, ERROR_MSG, PAYLOAD) VALUES (#{SAGA_ID}, #{STEP_NAME}, #{RESULT}, #{ERROR_MSG}, #{PAYLOAD})
mapper.select: SELECT STEP_NAME, PAYLOAD FROM TB_SAGA_STEP_HISTORY WHERE 1=1 AND SAGA_ID = #{SAGA_ID} AND RESULT = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY ID DESC
